title: Overtime offer
situation: A coworker covers your shift and asks whether you want overtime this week.
effect: Take overtime for extra pay, but lose some free time.

title: Side gig
situation: A small side gig is available if you want to spend a few hours on it.
effect: Put in some effort now for a modest payout later.

title: Ask for a raise
situation: Your recent work has been strong and you feel ready to ask for more pay.
effect: Ask for a raise. It may be approved or turned down.

title: New job offer
situation: A new job offers higher pay, but the commute is longer and more costly.
effect: Take the job and earn more, but add a commute cost.

title: Sell unused items
situation: You have things around the house you no longer use.
effect: Sell a few unused items for quick cash.

title: Freelance task
situation: A one-off freelance task pops up and fits your skills.
effect: Take the task for a short-term payout.

title: Wanted purchase
situation: A store has a wanted item you have been eyeing.
effect: Buy it now even though it is not urgent.

title: Impulse checkout
situation: Something small catches your eye near the checkout.
effect: Add an impulse purchase to the cart.

title: Eat out
situation: You are tired and considering eating out instead of cooking.
effect: Choose convenience over cooking at home.

title: Phone upgrade
situation: Your phone still works, but a newer model is tempting.
effect: Upgrade before it is really necessary.

title: Brand name choice
situation: You are choosing between a brand-name product and a generic one.
effect: Pick the brand-name version.

title: Unused subscription
situation: You notice a subscription you rarely use is still active.
effect: Keep it for now instead of canceling.

title: Budget review
situation: You have a free evening to look over the month’s spending.
effect: Review and trim the budget.

title: Track spending
situation: You wonder where the money is going each week.
effect: Track spending for a week and adjust habits.

title: Meal plan
situation: Groceries are costing more than expected.
effect: Plan meals to reduce food waste.

title: Shop for a better rate
situation: A recurring bill could be cheaper if you look around.
effect: Shop around for a better utility or service rate.

title: Cancel to avoid a fee
situation: A service is about to charge a fee you can avoid.
effect: Cancel the service to avoid the fee.

title: Compare before buying
situation: A needed purchase is coming up.
effect: Compare prices before buying.

title: Add to emergency fund
situation: You have some extra cash this month.
effect: Put money into an emergency fund instead of spending it.

title: Save part of a bonus
situation: A bonus lands in your account.
effect: Save part of it rather than spending it all.

title: Automatic transfer
situation: You can set up an automatic move into savings.
effect: Set up automatic savings each month.

title: Round-up savings
situation: A round-up savings feature is available on your account.
effect: Turn on round-up savings for small regular deposits.

title: Save a windfall
situation: A small unexpected amount comes in.
effect: Save the windfall instead of spending it.

title: Delay a purchase
situation: You want something now but do not truly need it yet.
effect: Delay the purchase and save the difference.

title: Take a small loan
situation: An urgent need is hard to cover right now.
effect: Take a small loan to cover the need.

title: Put it on a credit card
situation: You can charge a purchase instead of paying cash.
effect: Use a credit card for the purchase.

title: Pay only the minimum
situation: You have a balance and not much extra cash.
effect: Pay only the minimum this month.

title: Pay down early
situation: You have some extra money and a balance to reduce.
effect: Pay down the balance early.

title: Longer loan term
situation: A lender offers a longer term with smaller monthly payments.
effect: Choose the longer term to ease monthly cash flow.

title: Avoid a high-interest offer
situation: A tempting offer carries a high interest rate.
effect: Decline the high-interest offer.

title: Pay for a course
situation: A course could improve your skills and future options.
effect: Pay for the course now for possible future gains.

title: Get certified
situation: A certification could open better opportunities.
effect: Get certified to strengthen your path.

title: Take a less convenient shift
situation: A less convenient shift pays a bit more.
effect: Take the shift for higher pay.

title: Work now, study later
situation: You could delay education to bring in income now.
effect: Delay education and earn now.

title: Network
situation: There is time to build connections.
effect: Spend time networking for possible future opportunities.

title: Update and apply
situation: Your resume could use a refresh.
effect: Update your resume and apply for better roles.

title: Set aside for repairs
situation: Home things eventually break.
effect: Set aside money for future home repairs.

title: Rent vs buy thought
situation: You are thinking about where to live long term.
effect: Think through rent vs buy before deciding.

title: Maintain now
situation: A small maintenance issue is showing up.
effect: Fix it now to avoid a bigger repair later.

title: Upgrade trap
situation: A home upgrade looks nice but adds little value.
effect: Make the upgrade anyway.
